params.prompt: A seamless ambient loop. The starting and ending composition match, but the environment keeps moving at steady speed across the boundary; never settle to a still. One full slow natural motion cycle over ten seconds. One continuous locked-off tripod shot, exact reference framing and perspective throughout. The bathtub is a real rigid manufactured product: preserve every edge, silhouette, material, position and proportion perfectly. Architecture and camera are completely still. Constant natural exposure, no edits, no zoom, no camera drift, no morphing, no text. Motion is ongoing from frame one through the last second at the same relaxed pace, never slowing into a still. Photoreal premium design campaign, silent. This is the exact green NINFEA bath with its wide flat flared rim. Keep all rigid bath contours and limestone edges fixed. Not seedlings, no sprouting, no creeping new plants; this is an established lush garden alive with a light breeze. Clear restrained motion over broad areas, never just one leaf.
